subject: Quarterly commit spot-check: please validate amounts & SKUs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Quarterly commit spot-check: please validate amounts & SKUs

Team —

Quick ask as part of the close-of-quarter hygiene sweep for deals closing this month. I pulled a commit snapshot for Acme Retail (RDW-ACME-202611) and there are a few discrepancies we need cleaned up before we mark the commit:

- Amount: CRM shows $420,000 ACV but a recent quote spreadsheet implies $450,000.
- SKU mapping: two line items (SKU: RDW-ML-ENT & RDW-INS-1) aren't matched to Acme's internal product codes; see attached SKU-mapping-v2.csv.
- Next step / probability: Sales stage is "Commit" but next step text is generic. We should set a clear next step and adjust probability only after confirming PO timeline.

I've attached a short commit sheet (Acme-Q4-commit-sheet.xlsx) with current CRM values. Please do the following by EOD:
1) Ben — reconcile the quoted amount vs CRM; leave an audit note in the Deal record with the source of truth.
2) Grace — align SKUs and add Acme's product codes in the line-items.
3) Aditya — confirm that the close date in CRM is still Nov 30 and advise whether legal/pricing approvals are outstanding.

I'll draft a one-line note to Acme for confirmation once we've reconciled. This is time-sensitive for the quarter close — thanks.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa — quick update: I looked at the quote stack. The $450k total reflects an optional onboarding services line that was not converted into a separate paid SKU in CRM; someone pasted the services line into the product description. I created a separate line item and updated the CRM to $450,000 ACV.

Action items I left in the deal:
- Audit note: "Split services line into RDW-SVC-ONB, updated ACV to $450k per quote v2 (susan.lam@acmeretail.com)."
- Request Grace to confirm Acme's internal mapping for RDW-ML-ENT and RDW-INS-1.

Ben

Hi Susan — forwarding our internal checklist to make the close tidy. Short asks: can you confirm two quick things so we can finalize our CRM commit?

1) Final contract/PO amount — our system shows $420k but the quote we exchanged lists $450k (the delta is an onboarding services line). Can you confirm the amount you will PO for?
2) SKU codes — we want to include your internal product codes on the line items to simplify provisioning. The two Redwood SKUs in question are RDW-ML-ENT and RDW-INS-1; I've attached our mapping CSV.

If it's easier, happy to jump on a 15-minute call today.

Thanks — Marissa
